Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical data extraction error in its analysis of the WebSurfer's results. In Step 7, the Planner incorrectly stated that Jorge Brum do Canto's birth year was 1963. The WebSurfer's search results in Step 6 clearly showed that Jorge Brum do Canto was born on February 10, 1910. The Planner confused the film's release year (1963) with the director's birth year. This error led to the incorrect conclusion that Monte Hellman (born 1929) was born earlier than Brum do Canto (incorrectly cited as 1963), whereas the correct comparison (1910 vs 1929) shows Brum do Canto was born earlier.
